headline: Nvidia Reports Nine-Month Net Income Up 138% to $183.3 Billion
summary: Nvidia reported GAAP net income of $183.3 billion for the first nine months of fiscal 2027, up 138% year-on-year. Third-quarter net income reached $65.3 billion, a 105% increase.
why: Nvidia is the leading global designer of graphics processing units and semiconductor chips for artificial intelligence applications.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Net income rose 138% over nine months driven by high demand for AI hardware.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong financial growth driven by AI chip demand pushed Nvidia's quarterly and nine-month earnings significantly higher.
